name: Elena Ramirez
bio:
Elena Ramirez's meticulous nature found its perfect outlet in motorsport quality control. Growing up in Santiago, she was fascinated by the precision engineering of racing vehicles, spending hours observing local mechanics. After earning a degree in mechanical engineering, she started her career at a small automotive workshop before transitioning to karting. 

At Speed Kart Racing, Elena is known for her eagle eye. She has a knack for identifying minor defects that others miss, preventing potential mechanical failures on the track. Her innovative ideas for improving inspection processes have significantly reduced errors and improved the overall reliability of the team's karts. While some may find her attention to detail excessive, Elena believes that in racing, perfection is the only standard.

physical.description: Elena is a woman of average height with a warm, comforting presence.

quirks: Always carries a small magnifying glass.
Insists on using a specific brand of gloves for inspections.
Has a lucky wrench she uses for final adjustments.
